<h4 class="fw-bold fs-5 mb-2" style="color: #1e293b;">Materials Discovery</h4>

This project is aimed at developing ML and DL models for predicting various properties given input SMILES strings for various polymers.

::: {.project-details .mt-3}
**Researchers:** James Brock, David Fox, Moise Guran and Berenika Ewart-James   
:::

<h4 class="fw-bold fs-5 mb-2" style="color: #1e293b;">Cyber Project</h4>

This project is an adaptation of the CybORG CAGE Challenge 4, designed for training and evaluating reinforcement learning models (RLlib PPO) in cybersecurity scenarios.

::: {.project-details .mt-3}
**Researchers:**  Jack Woodcock, Jake Chastney and Jono Vincent
:::
